mapper.select: select la.id, la.status, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.source_type, la.rent, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number from lease_agreement la left join apartment_info ai on la.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join room_info ri on la.room_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 where la.is_deleted = 0 and la.phone = #{phone} order by la.create_time desc

select la.*, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number, lt.month_count lease_term_month_count, lt.unit lease_term_unit from lease_agreement la left join apartment_info ai on la.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join room_info ri on la.room_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join lease_term lt on la.lease_term_id = lt.id and lt.is_deleted = 0 where la.is_deleted = 0 and la.id = #{id} and la.phone = #{phone}
